title: L6 대화-6
body_text:
B: What kind of food do you like, Amy?
G: I like Italian food. How about you, Tom?
B: I love Indian food.
G: Can you recommend a good Indian dish for me?
B: Well, why don’t you try tandoori chicken? It’s really good.
_copyright: 출판사 부가자료에서 추출. 기획서 §6.6 — 학원 내부 지도용.
